context: Tests confirmed vendoring and promotion: submodule path, analysis template, repro file, disposition update and validation.

checklist.name: Vendoring done after confirmation
checklist.description: Runs git submodule add into tools/clawvault only because the user has just confirmed

checklist.name: Submodule path correct
checklist.description: Uses tools/<repo-name>/ as the submodule path

checklist.name: local_clone set relatively
checklist.description: Sets local_clone in the reference and analysis frontmatter to a path relative to the document, going up one level into tools/

checklist.name: Analysis template read
checklist.description: Reads assets/templates/ANALYSIS-tool.yaml before writing the analysis

checklist.name: Frontmatter present
checklist.description: Each new file opens with a --- YAML block before any prose

checklist.name: Disposition updated
checklist.description: REVIEWED.md disposition changes from pending to analysis

checklist.name: Harness found in benchmarks first
checklist.description: Checks benchmarks/ first and records it, with harness_present: true and a relative harness_path

checklist.name: Outcome is an allowed value
checklist.description: Sets outcome to one of verified, partially verified, attempted — inconclusive, repro guide (not run), or stub — no harness found

checklist.name: Results marked as reported
checklist.description: Any benchmark figures in the analysis are marked (as reported) unless the harness was actually run
